title: Base Game Version
description: Validates base_game_version in world template manifests and checks that it matches the current Minecraft version. Can suggest updates to bring base_game_version in line with the latest version.

100.title: Base Version Undefined
100.description: Checks that the world template manifest has a header/base_game_version field defined. This field is required for world templates.

110.title: Major Version Low
110.description: The base_game_version major version number is lower than the current Minecraft version. This may cause compatibility issues.

111.title: Major Version High
111.description: The base_game_version major version number is higher than the current Minecraft version. This indicates an invalid future version.

120.title: Minor Version Low
120.description: The base_game_version minor version number is lower than the current or previous minor version. Consider updating to ensure compatibility.

121.title: Minor Version High
121.description: The base_game_version minor version number is higher than the current Minecraft version. This indicates an invalid future version.

130.title: Patch Version Low
130.description: The base_game_version patch version number is lower than the current Minecraft version. Consider updating for the latest fixes.

131.title: Patch Version High
131.description: The base_game_version patch version number is higher than the current Minecraft version. This indicates an invalid future version.

500.title: Version Retrieval Failed
500.description: Internal error: Could not retrieve the latest Minecraft version from the database.

501.title: Version Parse Failed
501.description: Internal error: Could not parse the latest Minecraft version string into version components.
501.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data field contains the version string that failed to parse.
